s: Savasana (Corpse Pose) is a surrendering and grounding practice, a final resting pose. The name Savasana is derived from the Sanskrit words, wherein Sava means Corpse/Dead Body and Asana means Pose/Posture. Hence the name Corpse Pose. Included in all styles of Yoga, this traditional Hatha, Iyengar, and Ashtanga yoga pose is commonly practiced at the end of the yoga routine to: relax refresh rejuvenate the mind and body.
